title: Open Palm
description: Hold your hand up with all five fingers extended and spread, palm facing the camera. This is one of the signs the app can recognize automatically in Sign Recognition.

title: Closed Fist
description: Curl all fingers into your palm to make a fist, with your thumb resting on the outside of your fingers.

title: Thumbs Up
description: Make a fist and extend your thumb straight upward.

title: Thumbs Down
description: Make a fist and extend your thumb straight downward.

title: Victory / Peace Sign
description: Extend your index and middle fingers in a V shape, keeping the other fingers curled into your palm.

title: Pointing Up
description: Curl all fingers into your palm except your index finger, which points straight up.

title: I Love You
description: Extend your thumb, index finger, and pinky finger, while keeping your middle and ring fingers curled down.
